CUDA_C_32F.doc: 32-bit complex single precision floating-point type (represented as pair of real and imaginary part).

CUDA_C_64F.doc: 64-bit complex double precision floating-point type (represented as pair of real and imaginary part).

CUTENSORMP_PLAN_REQUIRED_WORKSPACE_DEVIC.doc: uint64_t: exact required workspace in bytes that is needed to execute the plan.

CUTENSORMP_PLAN_REQUIRED_WORKSPACE_HOST.doc: uint64_t: exact required workspace in bytes that is needed to execute the plan.

CUTENSOR_ALGO_DEFAULT.doc: A performance model chooses the appropriate algorithm and kernel.

CUTENSOR_ALGO_DEFAULT_PATIENT.doc: More time-consuming than CUTENSOR_DEFAULT, but typically provides a more accurate kernel selection.

CUTENSOR_ALGO_GETT.doc: Choose the GETT algorithm (only applicable to contractions).

CUTENSOR_ALGO_TGETT.doc: Transpose (A or B) + GETT (only applicable to contractions).

CUTENSOR_ALGO_TTGT.doc: Transpose-Transpose-GEMM-Transpose (requires additional memory) (only applicable to contractions).

CUTENSOR_AUTOTUNE_MODE_INCREMENTAL.doc: Indicates an incremental autotuning (i.e., each invocation of corresponding [cutensorCreatePlan()](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cutensor/2.8.1/api/cutensor.html#cutensorcreateplan) will create a plan based on a different algorithm/kernel; the maximum number of kernels that will be tested is defined by the [`cutensorPlanPreferenceAttribute_t::CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_INCREMENTAL_COUNT`] of [cutensorPlanPreferenceAttribute_t](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cutensor/2.8.1/api/types.html#cutensorplanpreferenceattribute-t)). WARNING: If this autotuning mode is selected, then we cannot guarantee bit-wise identical results (since different algorithms could be executed).

CUTENSOR_AUTOTUNE_MODE_NONE.doc: Indicates no autotuning (default); in this case the cache will help to reduce the plan-creation overhead. In the case of a cachehit: the cached plan will be reused, otherwise the plancache will be neglected.

CUTENSOR_CACHE_MODE_PEDANTIC.doc: All parameters of the corresponding descriptor must be identical to the cached plan (default).

CUTENSOR_COMPUTE_DESC_3XTF32.doc: floating-point: More precise than TF32, but less precise than float.

CUTENSOR_COMPUTE_DESC_8XINT8.doc: floating-point based on multiple int8_t values. The number of retained mantissa bits is computed at runtime to ensure the same or better accuracy than the native floating point representation.

CUTENSOR_COMPUTE_DESC_9X16BF.doc: floating-point composed of 3 bf16 values for a total of 23 mantissa bits.

CUTENSOR_JIT_MODE_DEFAULT.doc: Indicates that the corresponding plan will try to compile a dedicated kernel for the given operation. Only supported for GPUs with compute capability >= 8.0 (Ampere or newer).

CUTENSOR_JIT_MODE_NONE.doc: Indicates that no kernel will be just-in-time compiled.

CUTENSOR_MG_DEVICE_HOST.doc: The memory is located on the host in regular memory.

CUTENSOR_MG_DEVICE_HOST_PINNED.doc: The memory is located on the host in pinned memory.

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_BLOCKSPARS.doc: int32_t: if non-zero, request bitwise-reproducible results from a block-sparse contraction at a performance cost. See [cutensorCreateBlockSparseContraction](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cutensor/2.8.1/api/cutensor.html#cutensorcreateblocksparsecontractiondescriptor) for details. (default: 0).

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_FLOPS.doc: float: number of floating-point operations necessary to perform this operation (assuming all scalar are not equal to zero, unless otherwise specified).

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_MOVED_BYTE.doc: float: minimal number of bytes transferred from/to global-memory (assuming all scalar are not equal to zero, unless otherwise specified).

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_PADDING_LE.doc: uint32_t[] (of size descOut->numModes): Each entry i holds the number of padded values that should be padded to the left of the ith dimension.

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_PADDING_RI.doc: uint32_t[] (of size descOut->numModes): Each entry i holds the number of padded values that should be padded to the right of the ith dimension.

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_PADDING_VA.doc: host-side pointer to element of the same type as the output tensor: Constant padding value.

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_SCALAR_TYP.doc: cudaDataType_t: data type of the scaling factors.

CUTENSOR_OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_TAG.doc: int32_t: enables users to distinguish two identical problems with respect to the sw-managed plan-cache. (default value: 0).

CUTENSOR_OP_IDENTITY.doc: Identity operator (i.e., elements are not changed).

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_AUTOTUNE_MODE.doc: cutensorAutotuneMode_t: Determines if recurrent executions of the plan (e.g., via cutensorContract, cutensorPermute) should autotune (i.e., try different kernels); see section “Plan Cache” for details.

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_CACHE_MODE.doc: cutensorCacheMode_t: Determines if the corresponding algorithm/kernel for this plan should be cached and it gives fine control over what is considered a cachehit.

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_GPU_ARCH.doc: int32_t: Plan for a specific GPU architecture and not one associated with the context. Value should encode SM version via `10 * SM.major + SM.minor`. Currently only SM versions 80, 90 and 100 are supported.

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_INCREMENTAL_COU.doc: int32_t: Only applicable if [`cutensorPlanPreferenceAttribute_t::CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_CACHE_MODE`] is set to [`cutensorAutotuneMode_t::CUTENSOR_AUTOTUNE_MODE_INCREMENTAL`].

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_JIT.doc: cutensorJitMode_t: determines if just-in-time compilation is enabled or disabled (default: [`cutensorJitMode_t::CUTENSOR_JIT_MODE_NONE`]).

CUTENSOR_PLAN_PREFERENCE_KERNEL_RANK.doc: int32_t: Fixes a kernel (a sub variant of an algo; e.g., kernel_rank==1 while algo == [`cutensorAlgo_t::CUTENSOR_ALGO_TGETT`] would select the second-best GETT kernel/variant according to cuTENSOR’s performance model; kernel_rank==2 would select the third-best).

CUTENSOR_PLAN_REQUIRED_WORKSPACE.doc: uint64_t: exact required workspace in bytes that is needed to execute the plan.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED.doc: Resource allocation failed inside the cuTENSOR library.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_ARCH_MISMATCH.doc: Indicates that the device is either not ready, or the target architecture is not supported.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_CUBLAS_ERROR.doc: A call to CUBLAS did not succeed.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_CUDA_ERROR.doc: Some unknown CUDA error has occurred.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED.doc: The GPU program failed to execute. This is often caused by a launch failure of the kernel on the GPU, which can be caused by multiple reasons.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_DRIVER.doc: Indicates that the driver version is insufficient.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR.doc: An internal cuTENSOR error has occurred.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE.doc: An unsupported value or parameter was passed to the function (indicates an user error).

CUTENSOR_STATUS_IO_ERROR.doc: Indicates an error related to file I/O.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_LICENSE_ERROR.doc: The functionality requested requires some license and an error was detected when trying to check the current licensing.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_MAPPING_ERROR.doc: An access to GPU memory space failed, which is usually caused by a failure to bind a texture.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED.doc: The opaque data structure was not initialized.

CUTENSOR_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: The requested operation is not supported.

CUTENSOR_WORKSPACE_DEFAULT.doc: Aims to attain high performance while also reducing the workspace requirement.

CUTENSOR_WORKSPACE_MAX.doc: Highest memory requirement; all algorithms will be available (choose this option if memory footprint is not a concern).

CUTENSOR_WORKSPACE_MIN.doc: Least memory requirement; at least one algorithm will be available.
